title: Where Does Timbre Hide? Localizing Speaker Information in Speech Signals
abstract: arXiv:2610.29150v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Timbre similarity is a key evaluation target for generative speech systems, including voice conversion, speaker-cloning text-to-speech, and zero-shot speech models. When the generated voice does not match the target speaker, the problem often reflects imperfect separation of speaker-related timbre from content, making it important to identify where timbre information resides and which representations still carry it. Using speaker identity as a measurable proxy, we probe frequency bands, phase/magnitude structure, WORLD source/filter decomposition, voiced/unvoiced regions, self-supervised learning (SSL) layers, EnCodec/HuBERT tokens, and a 45-listener test across Mandarin, English, and Japanese speech/singing data. translated_title: 音色藏在哪里？定位语音信号中的说话人信息
translated_abstract: 音色相似度是生成式语音系统（包括语音转换、说话人克隆文本转语音和零样本语音模型）的关键评估目标。当生成的声音与目标说话人不匹配时，问题往往源于说话人相关音色与内容分离得不完善，因此识别音色信息存在于何处、以及哪些表示仍然携带音色信息就变得非常重要。我们以说话人身份作为可测量的代理指标，对频段、相位/幅度结构、WORLD声源/滤波器分解、浊音/清音区域、自监督学习（SSL）层以及EnCodec/HuBERT token进行了探测，并在普通话、英语和日语的语音/歌唱数据上开展了45名听音人的测试。研究发现说话人信息呈分布式存在：1–8 kHz的幅度和声道谱包络结构主导人类感知，8 kHz以上的频段仍具备机器可判别性，浅层SSL层暴露出紧凑的说话人信息……
tldr: 本文通过频段、相位/幅度、声源-滤波器分解、SSL层和神经编解码token等多维度探测实验系统定位了说话人音色信息在语音信号中的分布，发现1–8 kHz幅度与声道谱包络结构主导人类音色感知，而8 kHz以上频段和浅层SSL特征仍携带机器可判别的说话人信息。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically localizes where speaker timbre information resides in speech signals through multi-dimensional probing of frequency bands, phase/magnitude structure, source-filter decomposition, SSL layers, and neural codec tokens, finding that 1–8 kHz magnitude and vocal-tract spectral envelope dominate human perception while above-8 kHz bands and shallow SSL layers remain machine-discriminative.
